an3.19:0.3: What it takes to run a successful business; and what it takes to increase in the skillful.
an3.19:2.3: Note: Not “object of concentration” as BB has it. The samadhinimitta is elsewhere defined as satipatthana, i.e. the meditation that you do in order to get into _jhāna_. Nimitta, here and elsewhere in the suttas, means neither “object” nor “meditative vision”, but “cause”.
